transport.meaning: New desktop path for this mission only; original Light queues/transport/results are not retroactively approved.

qaPin: Use exact final published execution commit from this PR/handoff; helper derives HEAD and Light must compare it with the prompt. Any different candidate or adapter change requires a new reviewed run.
fixturePolicy: NEW unique source documents using verified existing own parties/catalogue, no new masters/grants/settings. Capture fresh current opening/protected snapshots; missing historical snapshots do not become passes and do not block independent new cases.
scheduling: D lane then P then S then M is preferred for liquid capacity. Cases may continue in other independent eligible lanes after a failure; a failed history closure does not gate another lane. Global unknown cash/stock/actor effects block affected writes until resolved. Use actual accepted deltas, never assume funds.

New paid model/API services or agent delegation
